CustomObject.description: A person in the evidence who is not a Contact, or whom the org will not let a package create as one. Pulled forward from Wave 2 by Matthew's ruling, Addendum 19. PERMANENT RATHER THAN TRANSITIONAL: architecture v3.0 states that shadow persons persist for a toggle-off customer and cannot reach the Altify map, because that map row requires a Contact. Every earlier framing treated promotion as this row's destiny; for most of the orgs that will hold one, it is not. Promotion exists and is a path, never an expectation.
CustomObject.label: AAO Shadow Person
